facts: Root-owned pins carry full or worker roles. Full peers open exec/control/sync/jobs; workers open sync/jobs and accept full-peer exec/control.
Existing workstation and CT 190 were already enrolled as full. Production unsigned peer updates were disabled.
The old updater used SSH and host administration still used Agent Hub credential APIs; these paths are replaced.

scopeCorrections.neriLocal: Legacy active registration has no hostname or endpoint and does not resolve as a distinct machine. No duplicate workstation identity was created, per coordinator direction.
scopeCorrections.staticOnly: Coordinator settled delivery to Claude setup-token, OpenCode Go and ST agent token. Codex and Pi OAuth are never copied; Codex uses per-machine device sign-in when needed.

secrets.source: Agent Hub storage decrypt helper under the backend unit environment; values written directly to owner-only files; only names printed. Existing OpenCode Go file reused.
secrets.privateSigner: Created with owner approval 30fd5a451cd3 in the workstation secrets folder, mode 0600. Never printed, logged, committed or copied to peers.

acceptance.focused: Signed release, static login, receiver, role, transport, rollback and installer checks passed through managed st check. Fleet/Tether types passed.
acceptance.fixtureFix: Full acceptance exposed an existing race: relinked hub test asserted metadata before connection completed. Reproduced with a gated peer response; fixture now waits for connected plus fresh cache.

deployment.hold: Integration hold kept throughout deployment and live proof; all lane leases and the hold released. st lease --list verified No active leases.
deployment.CT190Bootstrap: Authenticated Proxmox infrastructure exec installed a release checked by a trusted verifier; the older daemon could not reliably return exec results during bootstrap. Final signed no-op and tamper checks passed over the fleet link.
deployment.workerBootstrap: Infrastructure-only worker install; root pins installed after approved enrollment. The verified new receiver applied final updates over the fleet link.
deployment.firewall: Only the two worker addresses to workstation/CT190 TCP 7449 and CT190 to worker TCP 7449 were added to the lab rules. Workstation accepts the observed PVE SNAT address on its LAN listener. No public bind.

enrollment.neriLocal: No second identity: legacy alias is not a separate resolved machine.
enrollment.workerMode: Tether only; no UI service or data copy.

preservation.VM201Scope: Infra install/enrollment, static login delivery, signed update and infrastructure metadata only.

checks.detail: Agent-work ran Pi through the Aico auth wrapper using OpenCode Go; expected reply received; an invalid-key control was refused.
Both workers received the accepted release through push-update; their durable job results are exit 0 and installed files match the signed release.
CT 190 receive-update refused a modified signed payload over authenticated fleet exec (exit 1).
Agent-work push-update refused the older, correctly signed API-28 release (exit 1).
CT 190 push-update of the current release returned Already installed (exit 0).
st status --kind machine --all reports the workstation, CT 190 and both workers healthy and connected.
Repository search has no retired API or credential-push callers; backend HTTP access logs contain zero retired-endpoint requests in the recorded window.
